headline: Red Dead Redemption 2: 725 million in 3 days
title: Red Dead Redemption 2 Facts | 725 Million Dollar Launch | Classic Games
video_script: Red Dead Redemption two came out in October twenty eighteen from Rockstar Games. Development lasted over eight years, and it became one of the most expensive games ever made. It earned seven hundred twenty five million dollars from its opening weekend, the second biggest launch in the history of entertainment. You play Arthur Morgan in the year eighteen ninety nine. Do you love Arthur? Comment below!
description: Red Dead Redemption 2 (Rockstar, October 2018) took over eight years to make and earned $725 million in its opening weekend. Source: Wikipedia.
